title: 3 Bed · 2.0 Bath Single-Story Modern Scandinavian Residence
designer_rationale: Scheme 'Public-Private Zonal Split' demonstrated superior spatial efficiency (98.0%), optimal circulation (80.0%), and high bedroom acoustic privacy (100.0%). Site-first planning with South frontage, 5.0ft front setback, and 3 bedrooms across 1097.2 sq ft.
